title: Design System: SlipStream · House Lights (direction B)

logo.purpose: A Work's title in its own poster face, fitted per Work to a max width in one or two lines (15-92px). Gloock is the default face; Bebas Neue, Italiana, Bodoni Moda, Unbounded, Big Shoulders Display, Limelight, Archivo Black and Poiret One are assigned per Work with their own weight, tracking and case.

headline.purpose: Page titles. Phone large titles use weight 600.

title.purpose: Section heads. Phone section heads use weight 600.

row-title.purpose: Activity rows, aisle items, episodes, palette results.

overview.purpose: Work synopses on heroes, 54-62ch, clamped to 2-3 lines.

label.purpose: Sub-section heads in ink-2; never uppercase.

caption.purpose: Tile subtitles, column heads, timestamps; tabular figures, ink-3.

mono.purpose: Release names and file paths only.

shadows.name: work-poster
shadows.purpose: The large poster on a Work page.

shadows.name: ticket
shadows.purpose: Ticket stub, as a filter so the notched silhouette casts.

shadows.name: tile-glow
shadows.value: radial ellipse of the Work's glow, blur(30px), opacity 0 / 0.32 lit / 0.42 developed / 0.55 hover-focus

shadows.name: spill
shadows.value: blurred backdrop + two Work-palette radials, filter: blur(72px) saturate(1.45), opacity 0.56 (0.36 on Library, Series, Search), masked to transparent by 96%

motion.name: ease-house
motion.purpose: Default for transforms, tile lift, popovers, toasts, nav indicator, FLIP.

motion.name: ease-drawer

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Buttons, nav items, segments; 0.94 for icon buttons and tabs.

motion.name: tile-lift
motion.purpose: Hover or focus on a poster tile.

motion.name: house-lights
motion.purpose: House lights rising when nothing needs the admin.

motion.name: develop-front
motion.value: mask advance per tick; filter 600ms ease
motion.purpose: Develop colour front and stalled desaturation.

motion.name: vt-house-down
motion.value: old: 300ms ease-house to opacity 0, brightness 0.3; new: 520ms ease-house after 180ms; poster group 560ms ease-drawer

motion.name: vt-up
motion.value: old 220ms ease-out fade; new 360ms ease-house after 60ms

motion.name: spring-push
motion.value: sampled spring, response 0.36-0.5s, damping 1, as CSS linear()

narrative.overview:
The library is the light source. Every surface sits in a warm velvet dark, every word is set in screen-light ink, and the only colour on any screen is spill from the art: a heavily blurred copy of the current Work's backdrop that lights the top of the page, a per-Work glow behind lit tiles and activity rows, and each Work's title set in its own poster face. The chrome owns no hue. Two signal colours exist, amber for "needs you" and red for failure, and they are spent like aisle lights: few, small, and only where the admin must act.

Focus dims the house. Hovering or focusing a poster lifts it (scale 1.03), deepens its shadow, raises its glow and reveals its caption while every sibling in the same row drops to 40% opacity. Work in progress is a print developing: a grained monochrome poster brings up its colour left to right to its acquisition fraction. The house lights rise slightly on Tonight when nothing needs the admin and stay down while anything does. Requests, for Members, are ticket stubs that tear when the Work is ready.

Density is a calm desk register (15px body, 12px row padding, 64px column gaps) over full-bleed 21:9 heroes; the phone and the Member portal are the same room at a larger, softer size.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground; text is one ink at four opacities, never a second hue.
Colour comes only from the art: spill, glow, develop, poster faces.
Amber and red are state lights, never decoration.
Hover and focus are theatrical: one thing lifts, the rest recede.
Pill-shaped actions, soft-cornered posters, hairline rules instead of boxes.

rules.name: The Art Is The Palette Rule
rules.body: No chrome element carries a hue of its own. Any colour beyond ink, amber and red must come from a Work's palette in scope (spill, glow, develop, poster face).

rules.name: The Aisle Light Rule
rules.body: Amber means "needs you" and red means "failed or offline". Neither marks selection, brand, progress or emphasis. Selection is ink; progress is the Work's own glow.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Jost speaks for the house; the poster face speaks for the Work. A poster face never sets UI text, and Jost never sets a Work's title on its own hero.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every live number (rates, percentages, counts, times) uses tabular figures so ticking values do not jitter.

rules.name: The Stage And Stalls Rule
rules.body: Art occupies the top of the page full-bleed and fades out by mask; content begins in that fade, not below a hard edge.

rules.name: The Light Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Content on the stage is never boxed or raised to separate it; use a hairline or a glow. Shadows belong to objects (posters, tickets, overlays).

rules.name: The House Dims Rule
rules.body: When one thing is under the pointer or focus, its siblings in the same group drop to 40% (Coming soon rows to 50%). Hover dimming belongs behind a hover-and-fine-pointer query; focus dims on every device.

dos: Do take every hue from the Work in scope: spill behind the page top, the Work's glow behind its tile or row, its poster face for its title.
Do keep amber for needs-you and red for failed or offline, and keep them small: a 7–8px dot, a count wash, a row-edge glow.
Do separate list content with 1px hairlines at 8% ink, not boxes or cards.
Do make the single primary action an ink pill with on-ink text; everything else is a veil, fill or quiet pill.
Do lift one thing and dim its siblings to 40% on hover and focus, and show a 2px ink focus ring on every interactive element.
Do use tabular figures for every live number.
Do keep a 44px hit target on phone for every small control.
donts: Don't introduce a brand or accent hue in the chrome; the art is the palette.
Don't use amber or red for selection, progress, emphasis or decoration.
Don't set UI text in a poster face, or a Work's hero title in Jost.
Don't box stage content in raised cards or shadows; shadows belong to posters, tickets and overlays.
Don't uppercase or letter-space UI labels; uppercase appears only where a Work's poster face is uppercase.
Don't animate the command palette; it opens instantly.
